heading: Corporate mental health & workplace wellbeing
lead: Mental health at work is not a luxury — it is the foundation for high-performing, engaged, and resilient teams.
intro: With over eight years of experience in psychological counselling, I support organisations in Germany and Switzerland in building a culture that takes psychological wellbeing seriously. Workplace stress, communication difficulties, and emotional exhaustion have a real impact on individuals and on organisations as a whole — I work with companies and institutions to build psychological safety, resilience, and the conditions for people to do their best work, sustainably.

formats.heading: Formats
formats.intro: Tailored to your team and context.

items.title: Keynote Talks
items.body: Inspiring impulses on mental health, resilience, and mindfulness — for conferences, large groups, or team events. (30–60 min · online or on-site)

items.title: Workshops & Seminars
items.body: Interactive sessions combining evidence-based psychological approaches with practical tools and reflection. (2–4 hours · online or on-site)

items.title: In-Depth Trainings
items.body: Multi-day trainings for leaders and teams, designed for sustainable skill development in wellbeing. (1–3 days · online or on-site)

items.title: 8-Week Programmes
items.body: Structured wellbeing programmes supporting sustainable stress reduction, mindfulness, and emotional regulation. (8 weeks · 15–60 min weekly)

individual.heading: Counselling for employees & leaders
individual.intro: Confidential, one-to-one support as part of an employee assistance programme — available by arrangement, online.

items.title: Employee Counselling
items.body: Confidential counselling support for employees navigating stress, overwhelm, or personal challenges.

items.title: Leadership Counselling
items.body: Support for leaders navigating pressure, communication challenges, team dynamics, and emotional demands.

approach.heading: How we work
approach.body: My facilitation style is psychologically informed and relational, calm and engaging — combining theoretical grounding with practical, applicable tools.
approach.emphasis: Sustainable performance begins with people who feel genuinely supported — not just managed.

testimonials.text: Theresa Frische delights as a seminar leader with her comprehensive expertise and the perfect balance of theory and practice. With sensitivity and clear structure, she creates an atmosphere of trust in which learning and personal growth go hand in hand. A clear recommendation for organisations wanting to support their employees' health and development.
Theresa is an outstanding trainer whose calm, clear guidance and engaging approach made the experience both inspiring and easy to apply in daily life.

closing.heading: Let's talk about your organisation
closing.body: For enquiries about workshops, programmes, or leadership support, please reach out directly. I'm happy to discuss what would be most useful for your context.
